summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide managed infrastructure for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which is essential when you build, customize, or fine-tune your own models or need governance, reproducibility, and MLOps across teams. If you only consume a pre-built foundation model through an API (e.g., calling GPT or Claude), you don't need a full platform; these tools become valuable once you require custom training, private data integration, versioned pipelines, or production-grade serving and observability. The 2026 landscape is dominated by hyperscaler-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and unified data-and-AI platforms like Databricks, with specialized AutoML and MLOps tools filling adjacent niches.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go based on compute (training/inference instances), storage, and feature store usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: AWS-native AI/ML development where AWS is the strategic cloud and tight integration with AWS infrastructure, security, and application teams matters

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, prediction nodes, AutoML training hours, and generative AI token usage
platforms.best_for: Teams on Google Cloud wanting unified AutoML, custom training, and access to Gemini foundation models with strong data/BigQuery integration

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go based on compute instances, managed endpoints, and storage; no platform surcharge
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem seeking the OpenAI advantage via Foundry/Copilot integration and strong enterprise governance

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU (Databricks Unit) pricing plus underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload and cloud provider
platforms.best_for: Unified data, analytics, ML, and AI governance with multi-cloud flexibility when lakehouse, engineering, and generative AI share a common environment

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based subscription for teams and enterprise with self-hosting options
platforms.best_for: Deep experiment tracking, reproducibility, and collaboration layered on top of any training framework or compute

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing, custom quotes based on deployments and users
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated machine learning with strong governance and faster time-to-value for business analysts and data science teams

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise licensing/subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing automated ML with strong interpretability, open-source flexibility, and on-prem deployment options

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription and usage-based pricing for Inference Endpoints and compute
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models who need fine-tuning, hosting, and managed inference with the largest model/dataset ecosystem

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; cost is underlying Kubernetes/cloud infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Organizations standardizing on Kubernetes that want a portable, open-source, cloud-agnostic MLOps stack

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions available via Databricks and SageMaker
platforms.best_for: Framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model lifecycle management that plugs into virtually any ML platform

platforms.name: ClearML
platforms.pricing: Free open-source tier; paid Pro and enterprise subscriptions by usage/seats
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an end-to-end open-source MLOps stack covering orchestration, tracking, and serving in one platform
